@concat('"
WITH AID_CATEGORY_TBL
     AS (  SELECT MAX (ENRL.CREATED_DT) AS MAX_CREATED_DT,
                  ENRL.SBSB_CK,
                  ENRL.GRGR_CK
             FROM AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL
            WHERE     ENRL.CATEGORY = ''AidCategoryCode''
                  AND TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'') BETWEEN ENRL.CATEGORY_EFF_DT AND NVL (ENRL.CATEGORY_END_DT,TO_DATE (''12/31/9999'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))
         GROUP BY ENRL.SBSB_CK, ENRL.GRGR_CK),
     AUDITRPT
     /*Billing Entity doesn''t exists for Pre-Eligible members (FTE, HIPCE, HPE, PP and HIPFE)*/
     AS (SELECT DISTINCT
                GRGR.GRGR_ID,
                GRGR.GRGR_NAME,
                SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                NULL AS BLBP_EFF_DT,
                XWALK.ELIG_TYPE,
                CASE
                   WHEN XWALK.AID_CAT IS NULL OR XWALK.AID_CAT = ''N/A''
                   THEN
                      SUBSTR (ENRL1.CATEGORY_VALUE, 1, 4)
                   ELSE
                      XWALK.AID_CAT
                END
                   AS AID_CAT,
                ''Billing Entity doesn''''t exist'' AS ERR_MSG,
                NULL AS SYSTEM_UPDATED
           FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                   ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
                      AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = ''INMCDWP0''
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                   ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
                   ON     MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y''
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT>=TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                      AND SBSB.SBSB_CK NOT IN (SELECT BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
                                                 FROM CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO
                                                WHERE BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I'')
                      AND SBSB.SBSB_CK NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_CK
                                                 FROM CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP,
                                                 CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                                                WHERE GRGR_CK = 90 AND BLBP_VOID_IND = ''N''
                                                      AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = BLBP.BLBP_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''J''
                                                      AND BLBP_TERM_DT >= TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))
                JOIN AGP.INMM_HIP_ELIG_TYPE_XWALK XWALK
                   ON XWALK.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID
                LEFT JOIN AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL1
                   ON     ENRL1.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND ENRL1.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
                      AND ENRL1.CATEGORY = ''AidCategoryCode''
                      AND ENRL1.CREATED_DT IN (SELECT AID.MAX_CREATED_DT
                                                 FROM AID_CATEGORY_TBL AID
                                                WHERE     AID.SBSB_CK = ENRL1.SBSB_CK
                                                      AND AID.GRGR_CK = ENRL1.GRGR_CK
                                                      AND AID.MAX_CREATED_DT = ENRL1.CREATED_DT)
          WHERE XWALK.ELIG_TYPE NOT IN (''TEMP'',''HPE'')
         UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT
                GRGR.GRGR_ID,
                GRGR.GRGR_NAME,
                SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                NULL AS BLBP_EFF_DT,
                XWALK.ELIG_TYPE,
                CASE
                   WHEN XWALK.AID_CAT IS NULL OR XWALK.AID_CAT = ''N/A''
                   THEN
                      SUBSTR (ENRL1.CATEGORY_VALUE, 1, 4)
                   ELSE
                      XWALK.AID_CAT
                END
                   AS AID_CAT,
                ''Billing Entity doesn''''t exist'' AS ERR_MSG,
                NULL AS SYSTEM_UPDATED
           FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                   ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
                      AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = ''INMCDWP0''
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                   ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
                   ON     MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y''
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT>=TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'') 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP
          ON     BLBP.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
             AND BLBP.BLBP_TERM_DT >= TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')
             AND BLBP.BLBP_VOID_IND = ''N''
             AND BLBP.BLBP_CK NOT IN (SELECT BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK FROM CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO WHERE BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''J'')
                JOIN AGP.INMM_HIP_ELIG_TYPE_XWALK XWALK
                   ON XWALK.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID
                LEFT JOIN AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL1
                   ON     ENRL1.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND ENRL1.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
                      AND ENRL1.CATEGORY = ''AidCategoryCode''
                      AND ENRL1.CREATED_DT IN (SELECT AID.MAX_CREATED_DT
                                                 FROM AID_CATEGORY_TBL AID
                                                WHERE     AID.SBSB_CK = ENRL1.SBSB_CK
                                                      AND AID.GRGR_CK = ENRL1.GRGR_CK
                                                      AND AID.MAX_CREATED_DT = ENRL1.CREATED_DT)
          WHERE XWALK.ELIG_TYPE NOT IN (''TEMP'',''HPE'')
         UNION
         /*Billing Entity Suspended for Fully Eligible RP/SP/PC members*/
         SELECT DISTINCT
                GRGR.GRGR_ID,
                GRGR.GRGR_NAME,
                SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                BLBP.BLBP_EFF_DT AS BLBP_EFF_DT,
                XWALK.ELIG_TYPE,
                CASE
                   WHEN XWALK.AID_CAT IS NULL OR XWALK.AID_CAT = ''N/A''
                   THEN
                      SUBSTR (ENRL1.CATEGORY_VALUE, 1, 4)
                   ELSE
                      XWALK.AID_CAT
                END
                   AS AID_CAT,
                ''Billing Entity Suspended'' AS ERR_MSG,
                CASE
                   WHEN AU_BLEI.HIST_USUS_ID IN (''BMS'', ''APP_BILL'', ''faapp'')
                   THEN
                      ''YES''
                   ELSE
                      ''NO''
                END
                   AS SYSTEM_UPDATED
           FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                   ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
                      AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = ''INMCDWP0''
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                   ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
                   ON     MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y''
                      AND TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT
                JOIN AGP.INMM_HIP_ELIG_TYPE_XWALK XWALK
                   ON     XWALK.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID
                      AND XWALK.ELIG_TYPE = ''HIPFE''
                      AND XWALK.AID_CAT IN (''RP'', ''SP'', ''PC'')
                      AND MEPE.CSPI_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CSPI_ID
                                                 FROM AGP.ELOAD_IN_HIP_XWALK
                                                WHERE PREGNANCY = ''Y'') --Fully Eligible Pregnant Members
                JOIN CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP
                   ON     BLBP.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND BLBP.BLBP_VOID_IND = ''N''
                      AND BLBP.BLBP_TERM_DT >= TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                   ON     BLBP.BLBP_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
                      AND SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLBP.SBSB_CK
                      AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''J''
                      AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND IN (''X'', ''B'')
                JOIN  FACETS_AU.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO AU_BLEI
                   ON AU_BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK
                JOIN (SELECT MAX (HIST_CREATE_DTM) AS HIST_CREATE_DTM,BLEI_CK
                                FROM FACETS_AU.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI1
                      WHERE HIST_LOG_ACT_CD = ''U''
                      AND HIST_IMAGE_CD = ''A''                     
                      GROUP BY BLEI_CK ) BLEI1
                    ON BLEI1.BLEI_CK = AU_BLEI.BLEI_CK 
                      AND AU_BLEI.HIST_CREATE_DTM = BLEI1.HIST_CREATE_DTM
                      AND AU_BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND = ''X''
                      AND AU_BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL IN (''I'', ''J'')
                LEFT JOIN AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL1
                   ON     ENRL1.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND ENRL1.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
                      AND ENRL1.CATEGORY = ''AidCategoryCode''
                      AND ENRL1.CREATED_DT IN (SELECT AID.MAX_CREATED_DT
                                                 FROM AID_CATEGORY_TBL AID
                                                WHERE     AID.SBSB_CK =
                                                             ENRL1.SBSB_CK
                                                      AND AID.GRGR_CK =
                                                             ENRL1.GRGR_CK
                                                      AND AID.MAX_CREATED_DT = ENRL1.CREATED_DT))

  SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('Batchdate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'') AS RUN_DATE,
                  "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"  AS BATCH_ID,
                  GRGR_ID,
                  GRGR_NAME,
                  SBSB_ID,
                  BLBP_EFF_DT AS SBSP_EFF_DT,
                  ELIG_TYPE,
                  AID_CAT,
                  ERR_MSG,
                  SYSTEM_UPDATED
    FROM AUDITRPT
   WHERE AID_CAT IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ELIG_TYPE
"')

@concat('"DELETE FROM AGP.BILLING_AUDIT C 
WHERE (C.SBSB_ID,C.ELIG_TYPE,C.AID_CAT,C.ERR_MSG)  NOT IN (
SELECT A.SBSB_ID,A.ELIG_TYPE,A.AID_CAT,A.ERR_MSG FROM AGP.BILLING_AUDIT A JOIN AGP.BILLING_AUDIT_MATCHEDOP B ON
A.SBSB_ID = B.SBSB_ID  AND 
A.ELIG_TYPE = B.ELIG_TYPE AND
 A.AID_CAT = B.AID_CAT AND A.ERR_MSG = B.ERR_MSG )AND
 TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(C.CURRENT_DATE,''MM/DD/YYYY''),''MM/DD/YYYY'')< = TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('YesterdayDay')), '"'',''MM/DD/YYYY'')

"')

'WITH AID_CATEGORY_TBL
     AS (  SELECT MAX (ENRL.CREATED_DT) AS MAX_CREATED_DT,
                  ENRL.SBSB_CK,
                  ENRL.GRGR_CK
             FROM AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL
            WHERE     ENRL.CATEGORY = 'AidCategoryCode'
                  AND TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN ENRL.CATEGORY_EFF_DT AND NVL (ENRL.CATEGORY_END_DT,TO_DATE ('12/31/9999','mm/dd/yyyy'))
         GROUP BY ENRL.SBSB_CK, ENRL.GRGR_CK),
     AUDITRPT
     /*Billing Entity doesn't exists for Pre-Eligible members (FTE, HIPCE, HPE, PP and HIPFE)*/
     AS (SELECT DISTINCT
                GRGR.GRGR_ID,
                GRGR.GRGR_NAME,
                SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                NULL AS BLBP_EFF_DT,
                XWALK.ELIG_TYPE,
                CASE
                   WHEN XWALK.AID_CAT IS NULL OR XWALK.AID_CAT = 'N/A'
                   THEN
                      SUBSTR (ENRL1.CATEGORY_VALUE, 1, 4)
                   ELSE
                      XWALK.AID_CAT
                END
                   AS AID_CAT,
                'Billing Entity doesn''t exist' AS ERR_MSG,
                NULL AS SYSTEM_UPDATED
           FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                   ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
                      AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0'
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                   ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
                   ON     MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT>=TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy')
                      AND SBSB.SBSB_CK NOT IN (SELECT BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
                                                 FROM CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO
                                                WHERE BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I')
                      AND SBSB.SBSB_CK NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_CK
                                                 FROM CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP,
                                                 CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                                                WHERE GRGR_CK = 90 AND BLBP_VOID_IND = 'N'
                                                      AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = BLBP.BLBP_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'J'
                                                      AND BLBP_TERM_DT >= TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy'))
                JOIN AGP.INMM_HIP_ELIG_TYPE_XWALK XWALK
                   ON XWALK.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID
                LEFT JOIN AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL1
                   ON     ENRL1.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND ENRL1.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
                      AND ENRL1.CATEGORY = 'AidCategoryCode'
                      AND ENRL1.CREATED_DT IN (SELECT AID.MAX_CREATED_DT
                                                 FROM AID_CATEGORY_TBL AID
                                                WHERE     AID.SBSB_CK = ENRL1.SBSB_CK
                                                      AND AID.GRGR_CK = ENRL1.GRGR_CK
                                                      AND AID.MAX_CREATED_DT = ENRL1.CREATED_DT)
          WHERE XWALK.ELIG_TYPE NOT IN ('TEMP','HPE')
         UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT
                GRGR.GRGR_ID,
                GRGR.GRGR_NAME,
                SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                NULL AS BLBP_EFF_DT,
                XWALK.ELIG_TYPE,
                CASE
                   WHEN XWALK.AID_CAT IS NULL OR XWALK.AID_CAT = 'N/A'
                   THEN
                      SUBSTR (ENRL1.CATEGORY_VALUE, 1, 4)
                   ELSE
                      XWALK.AID_CAT
                END
                   AS AID_CAT,
                'Billing Entity doesn''t exist' AS ERR_MSG,
                NULL AS SYSTEM_UPDATED
           FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                   ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
                      AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0'
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                   ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
                   ON     MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT>=TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') 
        JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP
          ON     BLBP.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
             AND BLBP.BLBP_TERM_DT >= TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy')
             AND BLBP.BLBP_VOID_IND = 'N'
             AND BLBP.BLBP_CK NOT IN (SELECT BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK FROM CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO WHERE BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'J')
                JOIN AGP.INMM_HIP_ELIG_TYPE_XWALK XWALK
                   ON XWALK.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID
                LEFT JOIN AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL1
                   ON     ENRL1.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND ENRL1.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
                      AND ENRL1.CATEGORY = 'AidCategoryCode'
                      AND ENRL1.CREATED_DT IN (SELECT AID.MAX_CREATED_DT
                                                 FROM AID_CATEGORY_TBL AID
                                                WHERE     AID.SBSB_CK = ENRL1.SBSB_CK
                                                      AND AID.GRGR_CK = ENRL1.GRGR_CK
                                                      AND AID.MAX_CREATED_DT = ENRL1.CREATED_DT)
          WHERE XWALK.ELIG_TYPE NOT IN ('TEMP','HPE')
         UNION
         /*Billing Entity Suspended for Fully Eligible RP/SP/PC members*/
         SELECT DISTINCT
                GRGR.GRGR_ID,
                GRGR.GRGR_NAME,
                SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                BLBP.BLBP_EFF_DT AS BLBP_EFF_DT,
                XWALK.ELIG_TYPE,
                CASE
                   WHEN XWALK.AID_CAT IS NULL OR XWALK.AID_CAT = 'N/A'
                   THEN
                      SUBSTR (ENRL1.CATEGORY_VALUE, 1, 4)
                   ELSE
                      XWALK.AID_CAT
                END
                   AS AID_CAT,
                'Billing Entity Suspended' AS ERR_MSG,
                CASE
                   WHEN AU_BLEI.HIST_USUS_ID IN ('BMS', 'APP_BILL', 'faapp')
                   THEN
                      'YES'
                   ELSE
                      'NO'
                END
                   AS SYSTEM_UPDATED
           FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                   ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
                      AND GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'INMCDWP0'
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                   ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = MEME.SBSB_CK
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
                   ON     MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
                      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
                      AND TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT
                JOIN AGP.INMM_HIP_ELIG_TYPE_XWALK XWALK
                   ON     XWALK.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID
                      AND XWALK.ELIG_TYPE = 'HIPFE'
                      AND XWALK.AID_CAT IN ('RP', 'SP', 'PC')
                      AND MEPE.CSPI_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CSPI_ID
                                                 FROM AGP.ELOAD_IN_HIP_XWALK
                                                WHERE PREGNANCY = 'Y') --Fully Eligible Pregnant Members
                JOIN CMC_BLBP_BILL_PER BLBP
                   ON     BLBP.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND BLBP.BLBP_VOID_IND = 'N'
                      AND BLBP.BLBP_TERM_DT >= TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy')
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                   ON     BLBP.BLBP_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
                      AND SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLBP.SBSB_CK
                      AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'J'
                      AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND IN ('X', 'B')
                JOIN  FACETS_AU.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO AU_BLEI
                   ON AU_BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK
                JOIN (SELECT MAX (HIST_CREATE_DTM) AS HIST_CREATE_DTM,BLEI_CK
                                FROM FACETS_AU.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI1
                      WHERE HIST_LOG_ACT_CD = 'U'
                      AND HIST_IMAGE_CD = 'A'                     
                      GROUP BY BLEI_CK ) BLEI1
                    ON BLEI1.BLEI_CK = AU_BLEI.BLEI_CK 
                      AND AU_BLEI.HIST_CREATE_DTM = BLEI1.HIST_CREATE_DTM
                      AND AU_BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND = 'X'
                      AND AU_BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL IN ('I', 'J')
                LEFT JOIN AGP.ENRL_STATE_REPORTING_CAT ENRL1
                   ON     ENRL1.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                      AND ENRL1.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
                      AND ENRL1.CATEGORY = 'AidCategoryCode'
                      AND ENRL1.CREATED_DT IN (SELECT AID.MAX_CREATED_DT
                                                 FROM AID_CATEGORY_TBL AID
                                                WHERE     AID.SBSB_CK =
                                                             ENRL1.SBSB_CK
                                                      AND AID.GRGR_CK =
                                                             ENRL1.GRGR_CK
                                                      AND AID.MAX_CREATED_DT = ENRL1.CREATED_DT))

  SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE('7/30/2017','mm/dd/yyyy') AS RUN_DATE,
                  0  AS BATCH_ID,
                  GRGR_ID,
                  GRGR_NAME,
                  SBSB_ID,
                  BLBP_EFF_DT AS SBSP_EFF_DT,
                  ELIG_TYPE,
                  AID_CAT,
                  ERR_MSG,
                  SYSTEM_UPDATED
    FROM AUDITRPT
   WHERE AID_CAT IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ELIG_TYPE'
